title: Translation tools for newcomers to a country
why: Forms, signs, appointments and conversations are hard in a new language. Translation tools make everyday life possible while you learn.
what_is_different: Newcomers need camera translation for documents and signs, offline packs, conversation mode — and to know when to get official interpretation (immigration, legal, medical).

extra_modules.title: Offline and on the go
extra_modules.practice: Download offline packs and save 10 essential phrases

starter_project: Prepare a newcomer's toolkit: offline packs, saved phrases for doctor/school/transport, and a list of official interpreter services nearby.
pitfalls: Signing documents you don't fully understand
Relying on machine translation for legal or immigration matters

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
